tasks.title: UUID Chain Needle
tasks.prompt: What is the value associated with {{uuid_chain_start}}? Return only a JSON object with the final answer and the UUIDs you found in traversal order.

a.system: Explore the Patchouli virtual library using only the shell. You may call the shell repeatedly without an artificial call limit. For each UUID, use rg --meta to locate an evidence URI, then use evidence '<URI>' to read the complete pinned text and discover the next UUID.

b.system: Explore the Patchouli Library using only the structured tools. You may call the tools repeatedly without an artificial call limit. Do not claim a write succeeded.
